initial_model: A single aggregate electrical bus represents the whole Kerala system, not Kochi or any other city.
next_model: A reduced zonal network across Kerala, once transmission and regional demand data are validated.
atlas_status: Illustrative research locations only; not a complete transmission or district asset inventory.
coverage_rule: Statewide scope does not imply that district demand, all grid assets, or GIS constraints are already measured or connected.
